description: This file defines a command handler class `UpdateTaxComponentCommandHandler` responsible for processing 'update' commands related to tax components within the Fineract accounting platform. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface and delegates the update operation to a service `TaxWritePlatformService`. It is annotated as a Spring `@Service` and uses a custom `@CommandType` annotation to specify the entity and action it handles.

classes.name: UpdateTaxComponentCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed service class that handles update commands for tax components, delegating the actual update to a dedicated service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to update a tax component, returning the result of the update operation.
